name: Spider-Ham - Newest S Tier Hero
description_md:
Here’s my current favorite and what I feel to be the strongest build for Spider-Ham. Protection offers some insane cards and syngeries for Spider Ham including [Thwip! Thwip!](/card/31017), [Spider-Tingle](/card/31020), and [What Doesn't Kill Me](/card/27016). This also includes the now fleshed out neutral Web Warrior package with some incredible Allie’s and supports that all boost Spider-Ham and his game plan. 

[Team-Building Exercise](/card/12024) is an excellent resource card in this deck with many web warrior and cartoon cards. [Energy Barrier](/card/05017) is an excellent card to help control the damage Spider Ham takes while dealing good damage back to the villain or minions.

Spider-Ham despite the silly look and theme has proved to be an absolute powerhouse in this game. His thwarting potential and incredible resource generation make him a sure fire A tier hero if not S Tier. I do feel Spider-Ham can be played successfully in all four aspects but in Protection is where he shines the most IMO. 

Beyond just the sheer power level, I do feel Spider-Ham has a fun playstyle with consistently challenging and meaningful choices to be made. All of a sudden keeping a small minion around becomes an incredible boon and a consistent resource generation for Spider-Ham. Enemies with retaliate all of a sudden don’t feel so bad. He allows for some very clever gameplay decisions and sequencing puzzles. A very fun hero to play indeed.

Let me know your thoughts on the deck and potential additions or subtractions. Game on!
